title: Notion Business to self-hosted Outline
summary: Outline is a narrower product than Notion — a team wiki, not a database — which is exactly why the migration is cheaper.

you_lose: Notion databases entirely — Outline is documents and collections, with no relational views
you_gain: A genuinely fast wiki; Outline is the better product if documents are what you actually use Notion for
Markdown in, Markdown out, so you are never locked in again
Real full-text search that does not degrade as the workspace grows

caveats: If your team uses Notion databases as a lightweight app platform, Outline is not a replacement and this comparison does not apply to you.
Outline needs an external auth provider (Google, Slack, OIDC). Budget an hour for that on top of the estimate.
